review.finding: Ctrl+V calls clipboard.read() then readText() after an await; Safari/Firefox gate each read on a user gesture, so text paste may fail or double-prompt.
review.suggestion: Call read() once, take image or text/plain from the items; readText only if read() throws/missing.

review.finding: macOS Option+V matches via code KeyV and forwards ESC v after an async read.
review.suggestion: Restrict to ev.key === 'v' / drop the code widening.
